messages:
Anya: Postmortem follow-up for 2026-06-03 latency incident. We need owners, Jira links, and a clear handoff so action items don't stall. Can we pick owners today?

Felix: I'll own the KV cache investigation. Will open RW-7010 (RCA + repro + runbook update). ETA: 5 business days. R=Felix A=Anya C=DevEx I=Product.

Priya: I'll take autoscaler stabilization RW-7011. Plan: add dampening, add synthetic test, and CI gating. ETA: 2 sprints. R=Priya A=Eng-SRE C=Felix I=Infra.

Anya: Please add acceptance criteria to each ticket (repro, metrics target, rollback steps).

remediation-bot: Created RW-7010 and RW-7011. Link runbook RB-210. Reminder set: follow-up sync in 7 days.

Felix: Acceptance for RW-7010: KV hit-rate >=95% under 2x baseline for 30m, deterministic repro, runbook updated.

Priya: Acceptance for RW-7011: no scale-flap within 10m under synthetic oscillation, integration test in CI, canary rollout at 5%.

Anya: RACI for the record: RW-7010 R=Felix A=Anya C=DevEx I=Support. RW-7011 R=Priya A=Eng-SRE C=Felix I=Product.

Priya: I'm also creating an epic RW-7100 to track recurring scale/cache incidents and quarterly review items.

Felix: Jordan (cc) — can you create sprint subtasks and assign to us?

Anya: Jordan please create subtasks under RW-7010 and RW-7011 and slot into next sprint planning as P0.

remediation-bot: Calendar event: PM follow-up RW-7010/RW-7011 sync (in 7 days).

Samir: Proposal: 2-week rotating shepherd between Eng-SRE and Eng-Platform to keep follow-ups moving. I'll draft the amendment.

Felix: +1, will review the draft.

Anya: Thanks everyone. Next steps: Felix opens RW-7010 today, Priya opens RW-7011, Jordan creates subtasks, Samir drafts rotation change. We’ll reconfirm in the sync. :thumbsup:
